ThingDef.label: TIE pilot flight armor
ThingDef.description: This combat-ready flight vest provides additional protection against vacuum for limited periods. Its many models appeal to a wide range of users, from military pilots and mercenaries to fringe explorers and space pirates. Built-in grav thrusters also assist with movement in open space.
